question: What is the most money you have ever been paid for doing nothing?
story: I collected a five hundred dollar reward for finding a dog I had been feeding chicken to for a month. He started showing up on my porch in July. Big goofy shepherd mix, no collar, extremely confident. I put food out, he ate it, he left. This went on for weeks. Then a flyer went up at the coffee shop. Missing dog, deeply loved, five hundred dollar reward, and there he was in the photo, wearing a bow tie. So I called. The woman cried on the phone. She drove over, the dog strolled out from under my steps like he was clocking out of a shift, and she handed me five hundred dollars in cash. Here is what I learned two weeks later, from her, in the grocery store parking lot. He does this to four houses. He has a route. That dog was running a business and I was on the payroll.
